validity.recommendation: Keep the row (real line), but treat the sole GEM citation as effectively unsupported and replace it; existence rests on independent GulfPub + OGJ/Offshore-Technology, not the cited source.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — real, but the sheet's own sourcing is broken. All 8 GEM fields (status, fuel, type, capacity, length, diameter, owner) cite ONE URL: the Egypt Oil & Gas 'Western Desert: Egypt's Giant Petroleum Reservoir' report. That URL now resolves to an unreadable binary PDF that does NOT mention Salam, a spurline, 22-in, 250 MMcf/d, or 35 km (WebFetch confirmed 'no mention of Salam'). So the row is single-sourced to a citation that does not name the pipeline — an existence flag on the SOURCING. Independent corroboration that the line physically exists: (1) GulfPub PE World Map independently records 'Salam - WDGP-N' operating, 22.0 in, ~23 km, Salam field -> Western Desert Gas Project North Line, op Khalda Petroleum Co (diameter 22 matches GEM exactly). (2) OGJ (Khalda gas plant) and Offshore-Technology both state Apache/Khalda installed 'pipelines to deliver the increased sales volumes to the Egyptian pipeline grid in both the north and south of the country' from Salam. The northern of those two spurs = this line into the WDGP North (Obaiyed->Ameriya) trunk. Verdict confirmed-with-caveat: the line is real and correctly a gas transmission spur, but the GEM citation must be replaced.

validity.recommendation: Change Owner from 'General Petroleum Co' to Khalda Petroleum Company (operator; JV of Apache/APA + EGPC); GPC operates the Gulf of Suez, not the Salam/Khalda Western Desert concession.
validity.researcher_notes: ATTRIBUTION — owner almost certainly wrong. GEM lists Owner1 = 'General Petroleum Company (GPC)' 100%. Salam field and the Salam gas plant sit on the KHALDA concession, operated by Khalda Petroleum Company (KPC), a JV of Apache Corp (APA) and EGPC — stated by both OGJ and Offshore-Technology (two independent outlets), and GulfPub records the operator of 'Salam - WDGP-N' as Khalda Petroleum Co. General Petroleum Company / GPC (Al-Bakr) is a separate EGPC affiliate operating in the Gulf of Suez (Ras Gharib), not the Western Desert — so the 'GPC' attribution looks like a mis-assignment. Recommend Owner/Operator = Khalda Petroleum Company (with EGPC as the state partner).

validity.recommendation: Re-verify length (GEM 35 km vs GulfPub 23 km, ~34% delta) and capacity (250 MMcf/d, single-source only); fix endpoints (currently Salam->Salam). Diameter 22 in is corroborated.
validity.researcher_notes: SPEC — diameter 22 in is corroborated (GulfPub 22.0 in). BUT: (a) Length 35 km (GEM) vs 23 km (GulfPub) is a ~34% disagreement and the GEM value traces only to the broken single citation — unresolved, no second source agrees with 35 km. (b) Capacity 250 MMcf/d is single-sourced to the same unreadable PDF; no independent source confirms 250 MMcf/d for this specific spur (the Salam PLANT figures cited in trade press are 200-600 MMscfd plant throughput, not a spurline capacity) — treat as unverified. (c) ENDPOINTS are wrong: GEM StartLocation=Salam and EndLocation=Salam (both 'Salam'), which is a placeholder, not a real route. The line runs Salam field/GP -> tie-in on the WDGP North Line (Obaiyed->Ameriya trunk), per GulfPub 'Salam - WDGP-N'. Not a duplicate of any other GEM PID: the roster's P0476 (Salam-Abu Gharadig Southern, 18 in) is the distinct SOUTHERN spur (GulfPub 'WDGP South Line | Salam field->Abu Gharadiq GP, 18 in'); different diameter/destination.

routes.corridor_desc: Short (~23-35 km) field-to-trunk spur inside the Khalda concession of the Western Desert, Matruh Governorate. Runs from the Salam gas plant/field to a tie-in on the Western Desert Gas Project (WDGP) North Line, the Obaiyed->Ameriya (Alexandria) export trunk. Salam is stated in trade press to lie ~70 km south of Marsa Matruh (coast at ~31.35N, 27.24E); the start coordinate given (~30.7N, 27.4E) is an APPROXIMATE regional centroid for the Salam/Obaiyed Khalda field cluster, defensible from that '70 km from Matruh' anchor but NOT a surveyed point. The exact WDGP-N tie-in location is unknown (left null, not fabricated). Corridor is loosely bounded to the Salam-Obaiyed concession area; do not treat as a mapped route.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from GulfPub ('Salam - WDGP-N', Salam field -> WDGP North Line) plus OGJ/Offshore-Technology confirming Salam feeds spurs into the grid north and south. Exact geometry not sourced; start coord is an approximate field-cluster centroid derived from the '70 km south of Marsa Matruh' statement, end tie-in left null to avoid fabrication. No coordinates invented.

summary: P6693 Salam Spurline is REAL (indep. GulfPub 'Salam-WDGP-N' 22in + OGJ/Offshore-Tech), but single-sourced to a broken PDF that never names it; owner 'General Petroleum Co' wrong (should be Khalda Petroleum/EGPC), length 35 vs GulfPub 23 km unresolved, capacity 250 MMcf/d unverified, endpoints Salam->Salam bogus.
